description: Score AI output locally across the 10 TrustModel dimensions (safety, fairness, accuracy, privacy, transparency, robustness, accountability, explainability, compliance, reliability) and roll it into a 0-100 TrustScore. NO API key required — runs on this machine with a transparent heuristic judge. Returns trust_score, grade, per-dimension scores, and violations. Local scores are uncalibrated; use trustmodel_evaluate (cloud, needs a free TRUSTMODEL_API_KEY) for a calibrated, audit-ready score.

context.description: Optional context the output was produced in (improves judging).

output.description: The AI output text to score.

name: trustmodel_evaluate_local
